content: कलहः, -हम् [कलं कामं हन्ति हन्-ड <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 Strife, quarrel; ईर्ष्याकलहः <ls>Bh. 1. 2</ls>; लीला˚ <ls>Ś. Til. 8</ls>; so शुष्ककलहः, प्रणयकलहः <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 War, battle. .²3 Trick, deceit, falsehood. .²4 Violence, kicking, beating <ab>&c.</ab> <ls>Ms. 4. 121</ls>; (where Medhātithi and Kullūka explain कलह by दण्डादिनेतरेतरताडनम् and दण्डादण्डयादि respectively). .²5 A road, way. .²6 The sheath of a sword. .²7 A cry, sound; मदकलनीलकण्ठकलहैर्मुखराः ककुभः <ls>Māl. 9. 18</ls>. .²8 A part of west Bengal named Rāḍha.
